verdict.rationale: The pack does not document a self-service screen for requesting a transaction or card limit increase. The closest items are adjacent: per-vendor spending limits on virtual cards, approving fund requests through MCP or the CLI, and limits:write and spend_requests:write OAuth scopes on the MCP server. None of these shows a user-facing request-a-limit-increase flow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can request a transaction limit increase directly from a self-service screen
